  --public-origin   Public static origin for same-origin canonical metadata, such as https://www.example.com. 
  --live-origin     Live origin for RazorWire-managed hybrid interactions, such as https://api.example.com. 
  --hybrid-credentials  Hybrid credentials mode: auto (default), include, or omit. Choices: "Auto", "Include", "Omit". Default: <Auto>.
  -h|--help         Shows help text. Default: <false>.

USAGE
  appsurface coverage gate [options]

DESCRIPTION
  Enforce line and branch thresholds from a Cobertura coverage file.

OPTIONS
  --coverage        Cobertura XML path. Defaults to TestResults/coverage-merged/coverage.cobertura.xml. Default: <TestResults/coverage-merged/coverage.cobertura.xml>.
  --min-line        Minimum line coverage percentage from 0 to 100. Default: <0>.
  --min-branch      Minimum branch coverage percentage from 0 to 100. Default: <0>.
  --diff-base       Git ref or commit used with HEAD to estimate changed-line coverage. 
  --diff-file       Unified diff file used to estimate changed-line coverage without local git history. 
  --diff-stdin      Read unified diff text from stdin to estimate changed-line coverage. Default: <false>.
  --diff-label      Display label for the selected patch diff source in reports. 
  --repository-root  Repository root used for Cobertura and diff path matching. Defaults to the git worktree root when available. 
  --min-patch-line  Minimum changed-line coverage percentage from 0 to 100. Requires one patch source: --diff-base, --diff-file, or --diff-stdin. 
  --min-patch-branch  Minimum changed-branch coverage percentage from 0 to 100. Requires one patch source: --diff-base, --diff-file, or --diff-stdin. 
  --output          Output directory for coverage-gate.json and coverage-gate.md. 
  --github-summary  Append the Markdown report to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY when it is set. Default: <true>.
  --no-github-summary  Do not append to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY even when it is set. Default: <false>.
  -h|--help         Shows help text. Default: <false>.

ForgeTrust.AppSurface.Cli 0.2.0-preview.4

USAGE
  appsurface coverage run [options]

DESCRIPTION
  Run instrumented .NET tests and merge Cobertura coverage locally.

OPTIONS
  --solution        Solution file used for test project discovery. Supports .sln and .slnx. 
  --test-project    Repeatable explicit test project path. Skips solution discovery when supplied. 
  --exclude-test-project  Repeatable solution-relative test project glob to exclude from coverage execution. 
  --output          Coverage output directory. Defaults to TestResults/coverage-merged. Default: <TestResults/coverage-merged>.
  --configuration   Build/test configuration. Defaults to Debug. Default: <Debug>.
  --parallelism     Positive integer for non-exclusive test project concurrency. Defaults to 1. Default: <1>.
  --schedule        Project scheduling mode: input-order or longest-first. Defaults to input-order. Default: <input-order>.
  --schedule-timings  timings.json file used by --schedule longest-first instead of the output directory's previous timings. 
  --priority-test-project  Repeatable non-exclusive project path or file name to run first when --schedule longest-first is used. 
  --no-restore      Pass --no-restore to build and test commands. Default: <false>.
  --build           Build the solution once before tests, including explicit-project runs. Default: <false>.
  --no-build        Skip the solution build before tests. Default: <false>.
  --include         Coverlet include filter. Omit for Coverlet's project defaults. 
  --exclude         Coverlet exclude filter. Defaults to [*.Tests]*,[*.IntegrationTests]*. 
  --dry-run         Print discovery, scheduling, and artifact paths without running tests. Default: <false>.
  --list-projects   List selected and skipped projects without running tests. Default: <false>.
  --no-discover-exclusive  Do not auto-classify integration or Playwright projects as exclusive. Default: <false>.
  --exclusive-test-project  Repeatable project path or file name that should run exclusively. 
  --logg
